accept.status: real layout defect, pre-existing (0.7.0 and 0.7.1 identical); candidate fix for the next release
accept.reason: The final roof ramp (CollisionWalk-25/26, x -13.2..-8.5) starts on the unguarded south lip (z -20) of the y=12 slab; its rails (CollisionWalk-27/28) start at z -20.5 and the slab under the ramp has no headroom. The only way on is a 0.5 m sideways gap between the rail ends and an 8 m drop, under the 0.6 m capsule. Core's walker stands with the capsule centre on the bevelled lip (support normal 0.71 > 0.65), so the nested route traversal passes; a navmesh agent cannot. roof-start-west/roof-start sit exactly on that lip; the roof above (roof-final, roof-bridge, rooftop) is therefore a separate island. Fix: extend the y=12 slab ~1.5 m south of z -20 with a parapet, or end the rails 1 m short of the foot.
